spanish: O alma, cuando jurare a pronunciar con labios a hacer mal o a hacer bien, a todo lo que pronunciare el hombre en juramento, y se ocultare desde nosotros, y él hubiere conocido, y *será* culpado a una desde estas.
grammarChanges: el adam -> el hombre: translated the untranslated H120 lemma into a Spanish common noun with its definite article.
desde él -> desde nosotros: corrected the pronoun to match the 1st person common plural suffix on H4480, not 3ms.
conociere -> hubiere conocido: rendered the qal perfect (H3045) as a perfect-aspect finite form instead of the simple future subjunctive used for the surrounding imperfect/niphal clauses.
culpado -> *será* culpado: supplied an italicized finite copula so the qal sequential perfect (H816) has a finite 3ms predicate instead of a bare participle.
readerNote: Supplied the italicized copula *será* to give culpado a finite 3ms predicate and rendered yada'/H3045 as the compound hubiere conocido to mark its perfect aspect, distinct from the simple future-subjunctive forms used for the surrounding imperfect clauses.
